📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 up_close：close > close.shift(1)
  2. 计算 down_close：~up_close
  3. 计算 range_：high - low
  4. 计算 win：10
  5. 计算 up_sum：range_.where(up_close, 0).rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum()
  6. 计算 down_sum：range_.where(down_close, 0).rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum()
  7. 计算 up_count：up_close.rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum()
  8. 计算 down_count：down_close.rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum()
  9. 计算 up_avg：up_sum / up_count
  10. 计算 down_avg：down_sum / down_count
  11. 计算 ratio：up_avg / down_avg.clip(lower=1e-12)
  12. 计算 ratio_clipped：np.clip(ratio, 1e-12, None)
  13. 计算 factor：np.log(ratio_clipped)
  14. 计算 factor：factor
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_range_asym_log_short(df): df_copy = df.copy() up_close = df_copy["str">'close'] > df_copy["str">'close'].shift(1) down_close = ~up_close range_ = df_copy["str">'high'] - df_copy["str">'low'] win = 10 min_per = 5 up_sum = range_.where(up_close, 0).rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum() down_sum = range_.where(down_close, 0).rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum() up_count = up_close.rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum() down_count = down_close.rolling(win, min_periods=min_per).sum() up_avg = up_sum / up_count.replace(0, np.nan) down_avg = down_sum / down_count.replace(0, np.nan) "com"># Safe ratio: avoid division by zero by clipping down_avg lower bound ratio = up_avg / down_avg.clip(lower=1e-12) "com"># Clip ratio to avoid log(0) "kw">class="kw">or negative ratio_clipped = np.clip(ratio, 1e-12, "kw">class="kw">None) factor = np.log(ratio_clipped) factor = factor.fillna(0) df_copy["str">'factor_range_asym_log_short'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_range_asym_log_short']
